en.question: How many minutes are there in a whole week?
en.fact: 7 days × 24 hours × 60 minutes. A single day has 1,440 minutes.

es.question: ¿Cuántos minutos tiene una semana entera?
es.fact: 7 días × 24 horas × 60 minutos. Un solo día tiene 1.440 minutos.

en.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
en.fact: Bees build honeycomb out of hexagons because the shape holds the most honey for the least wax.

en.question: How many days are there in a leap year?
en.fact: The extra day, 29 February, keeps the calendar in step with Earth's orbit, which takes about 365 and a quarter days.

en.question: What is the name for a fear of spiders?
en.fact: Claustrophobia is a fear of enclosed spaces, and acrophobia is a fear of heights.

en.question: In chess, which piece can only move diagonally?
en.fact: Because of that, each bishop stays on squares of the same colour for the whole game.

en.question: How many cards are in a standard deck of playing cards, without the jokers?
en.fact: Add up every card, counting jacks as 11, queens as 12 and kings as 13, and you get 364. Add one joker and you get 365.

en.question: In what decade was the first fax machine patented?
en.fact: Scottish inventor Alexander Bain patented it in 1843, more than 30 years before the telephone.
